dataList.content:
Dammit, I was so close...
妈的……差一点就成功了……
dataList.place:
Daguanyuan Sparring Grounds

dataList.content:
... Did you ever really take the time to think about what might happen if big sister Yuanchun actually gained control of Hongyuan?
……你有没有想过，如果元春姐姐掌握了鸿园的权柄，接下来会发生什么？
dataList.title:

鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Sure, it's gonna be all buddy-buddy at first. She's going to acknowledge the authority of the board of directors, butter you up, and compensate you for your efforts...
虽然现在她会表面上承认与董事会的矛盾，并试图补偿……
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
... but soon, you're going to see people from other Nests coming in here and taking up administrative positions under the guise of "advisors".
但很快，其他各巢来的人就会借“辅佐”之名，行篡权之实。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
And it's the small families and clans that are going to suffer first.
随后小家族与其势力便会一个个地从他们的位置上被赶下……
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
And when that time comes, I bet you'll be saying the same thing then.
而到时候，你还是会那么说吧。

dataList.content:
"I was so close..."
只差一点，就成功了。
dataList.title:

鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
It's going to be a while before other members of your family are let go. You know this already.
你明明也知道的吧。你的家人们一时半会儿是不会被释放的。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
They committed treason, thinking they were piggybacking off big sister Yuanchun's forces, when in reality she had already discarded them even before it began. She's made sure that nothing about this treason's going to stick to her.
虽然你们仗着元春姐姐的势犯了事，但是姐姐已经把可能牵扯叛逆嫌疑的尾巴全都切干净了。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
... Mother. Father...
……母亲，父亲……

Now, let's think about this carefully, about Jia Yuanchun's vision for Daguanyuan. Will it be more H Corp.... or Q Corp.?
如此一来，你觉得贾元春所造就的大观园里，到底是H公司的人更多……还是Q公司的人更多？
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
... I see the point you're making.
……我明白您想说什么了。

But you've not given us any reason to trust you, either. What guarantee do I have that you won't just toss us aside when we're no longer useful?
但是我又怎能相信您？难道您就不会像她那样利用我们吗？

So, about that hiding place where you put your parents you just accidentally let slip.
刚刚你在慌忙之中说漏了你父母的藏身之处。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
I'd known their whereabouts for a while, actually. My Heishou had identified their location long ago, but I didn't do anything because there wasn't any evidence that pointed to your parents' involvement.
其实，我早就放出黑兽把位置都摸清楚了。但是，由于没有证据表明你的父母也参与其中，所以我才没有动手。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Is that... is that true?
此话……当真吗？

Just how low is your opinion of the Hierarch? Big sister Yuanchun made a big show of her own influence at the assembly, but I still have a tight control over the Heishou of the Family Hierarch.
你把家主当什么了？不管元春姐姐再怎么压着我的势头，指使黑兽都是我的固有权限。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
But... I thought you were arresting every member of the Shi family without even questioning them.
我……还以为只要是史家之人，就都会不由分说地被抓走……

What was it again? That leaders must take good care of those who are in the same boat as them?
我刚刚说过了。要珍惜志同道合的人们。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Why would any Hierarch go around arresting innocent people of H Corp. left and right, unnecessarily making more enemies for themselves?
反正这H公司里本来就没多少支持我的人，为何我还非得折腾无辜的人来减少我的支持者呢？
dataList.title:

I sure don't plan on doing that.
至少我不打算那么做。
